comparisons.peer_summary: Other expenses, consisting primarily of restructuring and restructuring-related charges, decreased to $179 million in fiscal 2024 from $862 million in fiscal 2023.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Qualcomm disclose significant changes in operating expenses or costs impacting their results for fiscal 2024. AMD highlights a substantial decrease in Gaming operating income driven by lower revenue. Qualcomm discloses a significant decrease in 'other expenses' from $862 million to $179 million, primarily due to lower restructuring and restructuring-related charges. While AMD's decline is revenue-driven and Qualcomm's expense reduction is driven by lower restructuring charges, both represent significant year-over-year variances in key operational cost/income line items reported in Item 7.
